eval_recalls: calculate object detection recall from ground truth boxes and proposals with configurable IoU thresholds
set_recall_param: normalize proposal numbers and IoU thresholds into numpy arrays for recall evaluation
print_recall_summary: print a formatted ASCII table of recall values across proposal counts and IoU thresholds
plot_num_recall: plot a proposal number versus recall curve using matplotlib for visualization
plot_iou_recall: plot an IoU threshold versus recall curve using matplotlib for visualization
